# What's your Earned Income Tax Credit worth?

> Free calculator for the federal Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC): the phase-in, plateau, and phase-out by number of qualifying children and filing status, the investment income limit, the married-filing-separately living-apart exception, and the AGI-vs-earned-income rule most hand calculations skip.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This calculator vs. working out the EITC by hand](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/eitc-calculator/vs-doing-the-math-by-hand.html)
